# Code of conduct

This project follows the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).

In short: be respectful and constructive, assume good intent, welcome newcomers, and keep
discussions about the work. Harassment, insults and personal attacks are not tolerated, in issues,
pull requests, reviews or any other project space.

Report unacceptable behaviour privately to **[security@b-stream.io](mailto:security@b-stream.io)**.
Reports are read by the maintainers only and handled confidentially; the maintainers decide on the
response, from a warning to a ban from the project, as described in the Covenant.
